rows.TEXT: In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Known in his times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended his reign of terror. He is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to his will.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.
Pegasus Knight"Lyf has been slain! Congratulations Milord - we have vanquished Mortis' dark angel..."

Marksman
"We have arrived at last, Milord! We must hurry! The elves are in great danger... Their city is west of here."

Elf Lord
"Greetings humans! We welcome your aid! A cursed Elf named Lyf has besieged us with his army of Undead beings! We know that Mortis must be behind this..."

Mage
"A cursed Elf? How is that possible... Very powerful magic must have been used! Who is so talented a magician?"

Elf Lord
"Our Oracles have told us that Mortis herself transformed Lyf into that infamy... She even gave him the power to control her minions! We will help you destroy him - but please, do not enter the Elven city, you cannot enter there!"
Destroy Dark Elf Lyf before he destroys the elves. Hyllia must not die.

Dark Elf Lyf
"What do you think you are doing, Humans? My actions are of no concern to you - be gone!"

Dark Elf Lyf
"You persist in your futile attempt to stop me? Mortis will tolerate your presence no longer! This is your last warning, leave now or perish..."

Dark Elf Lyf
"I'm afraid you have tested my patience long enough! Pray all you want, not even the Highfather can save you now..."

Cultist
"Bethrezen will make you pay for this! Your time has past! Prepare yourselves for the awakening of your new God!"
Acolyte"Milord, an elven messenger asks for an audience. He brings news of the Elven city!"
Elven Messenger"The Undead are breaking down our defenses! Our troops have not slept in days... The accursed dead attack us incessantly! Please hurry, before it is too late!"
Forest Elf"Empire, we need your assistance! Undead Hordes have attacked our city! Please, let me guide you to my Lord Hyllia... Humans cannot enter Elven Lands, I will guide you there."
Ranger "We have arrived in a strange place indeed, Milord... Nothing grows upon these wasted lands. We should be cautious! And keep watch for any weird creatures this land may bring!"

Dark Elf Lyf 
"Yes, caution is advised... But it is too late! the weird creatures seek you ! Ha! I warned you not to trifle with me... This time, I will offer Mortis your corpses! Ha ha ha!"
Demonologist"Fight all you want, humans! Bethrezen's birth is near! It is too late, you all will suffer a millennia of pain..."

Fighter
"The city is empty, Milord... Not one living soul! It seems that Mortis' minions cleared the streets with pestilential winds!"

Fighter
"How dare you attack us... Mortis will transform you as she did Lyf the Elf!"

Mage"This was is an ancient Elven city... Look here! These pictures portray Lyf before he was transformed by Mortis into a Dark Elf! The elves had no choice but to abandon the city after his transformation... He is a dangerous adversary!"

Mermaid
"Welcome humans... I was sent by the Elves to aid you. I will protect you until we reach elven territory. They are on the island in Ullguth's lake, west of here."

Ranger
"The elves have been vanquished, Milord... Nothing stands between our forces and the Undead Hordes now! We are outnumbered!"

Lollena Greenlief
"I have had enough of the Undead's attacks... I will get rid of the problem right now!"

Elf Lord Hyllia
"Wait Lollena, that is madness... They are still too strong for our armies!"

Lollena Greenlief
"No! Nobody will defeat the Elves! I can wait no longer, I must accomplish this task... The Undead should be destroyed!"
Elf Lord Hyllia"As you wish, Lollena... I cannot defy your wishes! But please be careful, the elf nation needs you..."

Forest Elf
"We must hurry, my Empire friends. The Elven city is west of here, on an island. I don't know how much longer they can last..."
My spells can help you in your quest.
Take a look at my wares, I may have something of interest to you.

My wolves will protect you with their life...
